name: rius-coding-agents
description: Rius observability for coding agents: track Claude Code, Codex and Cursor usage and cost per developer and per session.

plugins.name: rius
plugins.description: Stream Claude Code, Codex and Cursor sessions to Rius as OpenTelemetry traces: prompts, model calls, tokens, cost, tool calls and subagents, per developer and per session. Codex and Cursor are in beta; Cursor reports no tokens or cost.
